codex2 SOURCE-ONLY ADVISORY, not implementation evidence or a formal verdict. Canonical BUG-2017 compatibility comment posted; full focused report /tmp/codex2-bug2017-s2-compat-advisory.txt. Pins main c7b3f26d68e6b60c26757ee520887f6f89bbdaad and committed pending766bbcbc4c726118d625002f04583111b3fdbaed; dirty S2 implementation untouched.

Five decisive cases for the existing signed S2 implementation/test plan:
1. NodeConfig/NodeRegistryEntry currently REQUIRE legacy user_id+hostname. Defaulting them to0/empty would legitimize corrupt legacy records and owner() invents person0. Preserve numeric/string IDs and optional old name/user semantics; true opaque-only serialization roundtrip plus malformed/mixed records refusal. Existing opaque_binding_survives_case_insensitive_display_lookup_and_update still serializes a legacy identity, so is not privacy proof. WORK must avoid register_node_full_identity/register_specific_full_named/preferences and human label capture entirely.
2. init fresh/sibling seed_meta_requirements uses separately constructed RequirementsStore before node registration; binding file alone is insufficient. Actual provider before all seed paths (including missing-type-protocol repair), exact project/store common-Git context; cold noflag CLI+MCP first defect and restart. CloneDispenser created with inner=None before HOME flag cannot become configured HOME provider by later flag change alone.
3. File/SQLite state values are last consumed; AgreedIdBlock.next is next unconsumed. Preserve reserved-unsaved per-type floors, migration restart/partial state, actual linked-worktree simultaneous bootstrap and stable UUID. Existing same-path concurrent/first-initialization tests do not cover that migration topology. Keep wrong/stale/failing provider and exhaustion negatives.
4. Simple32 UUID/case canonical lookup; don't rewrite requirement UUID/spec/agreed/relationship identity to hide old node labels. Legacy readable evidence remains subject to1742 scanner/history refusal, no exemption.
5. Synthetic WORK/HUB/HOME promotion twice: UUIDs, old+new lookup, relationships/comments and no second counter/ref churn, plus existing-HOME provider/block transition. Existing merge-gate collision/no-op tests prove only pieces.

No replacement design/callsite inventory, source edits, tests/Cargo, claims, real HOME enrollment, grants/env authority switches, transport or live queue/mail tests. Full signed S2/S3 and1742/1843 ownership remain retained; final new-head formal independent review still required. Advisory turn complete; ready for explicitly routed new-head review/rework question.
subject: BUG2017 S2 compatibility: five decisive cases (advisory)
